title: Kamishiro Rui — Blowing In The Evening Breeze〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When are they gonna get here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure they'll be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, hi, everyone☆
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, were you all awaiting our arrival?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, we did ask for you all to come here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for stopping by on such short notice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's our pleasure!
Now, what is this thing that you said you wanted to show us...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
We've really been wondering what you had in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You'll get to see it right away!
But first, we'll need to head over to the stage♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The stage? Does that mean we get to see a show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: C'mon, Rui! We gotta hurry☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm right behind you.
There's no need to pull.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone! Rui and the others are here!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Welcome! We've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you're...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: As lonely as it was, I had fun!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I got to do what I really wanted to do, and it ended up being super duper fun!!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I got to do a show all by myself, but I still wanted to do one with everybody.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Then, Miku and the others helped come up with a flying show that we can all do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And that's what we're here to show you today☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, I realized just now that I really understand how Birdie felt...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As lonely as it was to do a show all alone, it must've been really fun to do everything they wanted...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our feathered friend, Miku and all the others must've thought very hard on this while we were away.)

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: We're not using the flying train, but it's still really great! We all really get to fly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're all smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to seeing that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, we're all set over here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Us too. Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, Luka, don't fall asleep here! Wake up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, shall we head to the seats?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We're looking forward to seeing your show, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Break a leg, Birdie!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Thanks! I hope you're ready!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright...
It's showtime!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was such an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! The way they used all those different jumping techniques was very interesting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The main flying scene was also spectacular. Not only did they have some fun wire stunts, they made it feel so real by cleverly moving their backdrops around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! That means it was totally worth the effort!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I was really surprised when they told me about that part! I didn't know you could do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We thought really long and hard about it because we wanted to fly with you☆

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, everyone! That makes me feel really happy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The joy of being able to put on the show you want alongside your friends with the stunts and effects you were hoping for...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nothing beats that honestly.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Rui, you seem awfully happy!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because we got to see a very fun show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miku, Birdie...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us such a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
You're super welcome!
